Train Cooperative Learning Model for Multi-Omics Survival Analysis

Source: R/Coop_Cox.r
train_cooplearning.Rd

Trains a cooperative Lasso Cox regression model integrating 2 or 3 omics layers. An internal validation subset is held out for lambda selection via cross-validation. Can be called directly or via train_j_models.

Usage

train_cooplearning(
  X_list,
  y_training,
  val_fraction = 0.1,
  lambdaVector = seq(0.1, 0.9, 0.1),
  folds = 5,
  alpha = 1,
  maxit = 100,
  seed = 123
)

Arguments

X_list

Named list of 2 or 3 omics matrices (samples x features). Row names must be sample identifiers, consistent across all layers.

y_training

Data frame with overall_survival and status columns. Row names must match sample identifiers in X_list.

val_fraction

Numeric proportion of training samples to hold out as internal validation for lambda selection. Default is 0.1.

lambdaVector

Numeric vector of lambda values to evaluate. Default is seq(0.1, 0.9, 0.1).

folds

Integer number of cross-validation folds. Default is 5.

alpha

Numeric cooperation parameter: 1 for 2 layers, 0.5 for 3. Default is 1.

maxit

Integer maximum iterations. Default is 1000.

seed

Integer seed. Default is 123.

Value

A list with:

  • model: Trained cooplasso model.

  • selected_lambda: Optimal lambda selected by CV.

  • selected_features: Non-zero coefficient feature names.

  • pred: Named numeric vector of risk scores for the full input set (train + internal validation reassembled in original order).

  • omics: Names of omics layers used.

References

Hahn G, Prokopenko D, Hecker J, Lutz SM, Mullin K, Sejour L, Hide W, Vlachos I, DeSantis S, Tanzi RE, Lange C. Prediction of disease-free survival for precision medicine using cooperative learning on multi-omic data. Briefings in Bioinformatics, 25(4):bbae267, July 2024. doi:10.1093/bib/bbae267
